evidence: The 1992 HDSD Table III and the 1946 Table I share the 429-flight denominator, resting protocol, two-hour dwell and corresponding 35,000-ft or 3.5-psia altitude. The HDSD prints 2.3% serious DCS. The identical 2.3% in the original is gas-pain descent. Bends with chokes and chokes alone are printed separately at 0.93% and 1.6%. The historical category difference cannot be adjudicated and supplies no new serious DCS count.
